fusions.name: Dabbling Dose
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Finally Bothered
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles. Each sting deals 26 damage and is always a critical hit. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Skimming the Pond

riders.text: you skim over it 10% faster than over ground
your dodge chance rises by 8% while you are on it
your stamina recovers 20% faster while you are on it

fusions.desc: You hover across water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 8%, and from gold your stamina recovers 20% faster.
